exposure: Fasting glycemia (FG) levels at the first prenatal visit
cohort: 1584 pregnant women with a recorded FG level <7 mmol/L before 24 weeks of gestation and delivery after 24 weeks.
finding: Only the highest FG category (5.6<FG<7 mmol/L) at the first prenatal visit was significantly associated with an increased risk of GDM, hyperbilirubinemia, shoulder dystocia/birth injury, and preeclampsia.
